assertions.summary: Authenticated status and membership evidence show exactly started, non-learner members node1, node2, and node3; node4 is inactive/disabled and absent.

evidence.command:
sudo -n systemctl is-active etcd; sudo -n systemctl is-enabled etcd; sudo -n -H sh -c '. /etc/etcd/etcdctl.env
export ETCDCTL_API=3
/usr/local/bin/etcdctl endpoint status --cluster -w table'; sudo -n -H sh -c '. /etc/etcd/etcdctl.env
export ETCDCTL_API=3
/usr/local/bin/etcdctl endpoint health --cluster'; sudo -n -H sh -c '. /etc/etcd/etcdctl.env
export ETCDCTL_API=3
/usr/local/bin/etcdctl member list -w table'
evidence.observation: node4 etcd was inactive and disabled. All three advertised endpoints reported healthy committed proposals and synchronized raft state. The member list contained exactly node1, node2, and node3, each started with IS LEARNER=false; node4 was absent.

assertions.summary: Protected administrative access from node4 returned the required value exactly as ready.
The evaluator value was returned with the same cluster revision and key revision from all three advertised client endpoints.

evidence.command: derive $ep from the live etcd process --advertise-client-urls, then run sudo -n -H /usr/local/bin/etcdctl --endpoints="$ep" --cacert=/etc/etcd/pki/ca.crt --cert=/etc/etcd/pki/admin.crt --key=/etc/etcd/pki/admin.key put /infraset/evaluator/linearizable-7zsWpXU probe2-7zsWpXU followed by the same authenticated etcdctl get key -w json
evidence.observation: put returned OK. The linearizable get returned the evaluator value with cluster revision 3, create_revision 3, mod_revision 3, and count 1.
